name: Sullied Love
source:
Your wife is happily married to you for four years and you couldn't be happier for having such a beautiful and lovely wife. 

But you had no idea that your life was not going to be the same anymore including your relationship with your wife upon the arrival of an unexpected guest who knew your wife from the past. 

Play the game and find out what changes to you and your wife's lives are going to happen and how your relationship with your wife would be tested.

[From [url=https://sleepy-devs.itch.io/sullied-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你的妻子与你幸福地结婚了四年，你为拥有如此美丽可爱的妻子而感到高兴。

但你不知道，当一位不速之客到来时，你的生活将不再一样，包括你和妻子的关系，而这位客人以前就认识你的妻子。

玩游戏，看看你和你妻子的生活将会发生什么变化，以及你和妻子的关系将受到怎样的考验。

[来自[url=https://sleepy-devs.itch.io/sullied-love]Itch.io[/url]]
